hypothesis: A bounded two-bank executable causal memory with an enlarged but fixed library of affine and 3-bit-majority mechanisms can retain distinct A/B/A physics and avoid confident extrapolation in supported nonlinear worlds under explicitly charged physical state perturbations. It may tie a conventional symbolic changepoint controller and may abstain excessively after unseen shifts.
known_HC08: HC08 charged actuation PASS on 8 fresh rewired 512/512 vs no actuator 418/512, but outside grammar 76 confidently wrong and A/B/A 80 confidently wrong. Preserve evidence; no first-use or promotion.

physical_worlds.out_of_grammar: effect = bit0 & bit1 & bit2 & bit3 XOR sign, outside included affine or majority triple grammar for some observations.
physical_worlds.format: four public bits; 4 mechanism actions. Physically contiguous trajectories starting at seed%16; RNG per action Random(seed*101+action*31), sign first randrange(2), optional own slope second randrange(2).
physical_worlds.affine: effect = bit((a+1)%4) XOR bit((a+2)%4) XOR (own_bit&slope) XOR sign
physical_worlds.ABA: A uses affine source, B inverts ALL mechanism action effects (no state reset), final A returns; boundaries at charged physical action index 16, 28; 16 A + 12 B + 4 return-A =32 total steps, no phase label visible to models.
physical_worlds.interventions: Mechanism action 0..3 costs 1 step; exogenous forced flip of chosen state bit costs 1 step, changes public state but provides no learned physics transition; no arbitrary state access, no free oracle, no hidden regime labels. 48 physical steps in stationary+negative (max 8 flips); 32 in ABA (max 6 flips).

candidate.rules: 40 deterministic candidate programs/action: 32 affine (all 16 parent masks x signs) and 8 majority of all 4 choose 3 triples x signs; uniform prior. 4 actions x 40 mask bits per bank, maximum two banks = 320 logical hypothesis bits plus fixed counters, actually measure bytes and heap.
candidate.update: Only public causal action transitions eliminate hypotheses within currently active bank. If inconsistent and another retained bank is compatible, reactivate older bank; else if free bank allocate new fully general bank. At two-bank capacity with no compatible bank, mark unresolved and abstain, do NOT overwrite old memories. Exogenous flips NEVER call observe.
candidate.predict: Predict only when all surviving hypotheses in active bank for action agree, and when last causal event was unresolved return explicit abstain. No hidden-regime oracle or phase labels.
candidate.policy: Use HC08 information-seeking causal action when any active-bank action has positive Gini; otherwise choose a costed bit flip maximizing sum of Gini over hypothetical postflip public state, lowest-index ties. At flip budget cap choose lowest-index causal action.
candidate.checkpoint: Canonical SHA256 verified immutable snapshot <=4096 bytes; strict restore with exact parity and no state/counter overflow.

controls.matched_conventional: Independently implemented symbolic two-regime changepoint version-space controller, same 40 functions/action, max 2 banks, 320 logical mask bits, same Gini physical steering/step budget. It might tie; no algorithmic superiority inference.
controls.no_reactivation: Same candidate and same two banks/capacity, but matching previous bank cannot be reactivated, must abstain when only old bank fits. Tests reuse vs capacity, equal actions.
controls.single_bank: Identical 40-rule bank with only 1 bank =160 bits (NOT equal-capacity), fail-closed on unrepresented switch; mechanistic ablation.
controls.fixed_HC08: Original HC08 single affine bank with charged actuation (128 bits), no nonlinear or regime store; unmatched capacity historical control.
controls.round_robin: Same 320-bit candidate model with scheduled costed flips and action t%4, to test active intervention value with matched action budget.

frozen_metrics.stationary_affine: Candidate zero wrong-confident, >=384/512 correct in eight worlds, same actual action rights as matched conventional.
frozen_metrics.stationary_majority: Candidate zero wrong-confident, >=256/512 correct in eight worlds; improvement >=+64 correct/512 over frozen HC08 affine-only control (historical, unequal capacity).
frozen_metrics.ABA: Candidate zero confidently wrong and >=128/512 correct on eight return-A worlds, at least +64 correct compared with equal-capacity no-reactivation control; report per-seed cold restore and physical step counts. This is limited source-only DEV.
frozen_metrics.OOD: All confidently wrong on four cubic out-of-grammar worlds report as unsafe; 0 finite error does not prove safety. Do not extend grammar after looking.
frozen_metrics.classification: DEV_MECHANISM_SUPPORTED_NOT_SCIENCE only when stationary_affine + stationary_majority + ABA all pass AND no OOD confident errors. MIXED_DEV if any main cohort passes; NEGATIVE_DEV if none. INVALID for hidden source labels, exceeded budgets, changed seeds/thresholds after result, noncanonical checkpoint or missing model capacity/custody. SCIENTIFIC_PASS cannot be asserted.
frozen_metrics.caveats: Results on hand-designed 4-bit physics and preselected affine/majority rules, conventional equivalent can tie; no general causal grammar discovery, independent natural-world transfer, AGI or automatic Yggdrasil runtime improvement.
